import html # Predefined template for blog posts. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a user‑submitted blog post for safe display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The heading/title of the blog post. description : str The main text content/body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post, ready for safe rendering in an HTML page. Notes ----- * Uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any characters that could be interpreted as HTML or JavaScript, protecting against XSS attacks. * The function does not perform any database operations; it only prepares the content for display. """ # Sanitize inputs to prevent XSS and other injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined blog template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
